title: LET'S GET SEXY: Erotic Stories Deconstructed
author: Let's Get Sexy
description: An Erotic/Comedy (Aka: Eromedy) Podcast where I read a NSFW erotic story, and you listen to it! (then I talk about it for a bit afterwards) Each week I delve into another exciting chapter of a red hot erotic story from the Literotica archives, reading it in full; with my best sexy British narrators voice... Then, we launch into a comedic breakdown of the characters, the sex scenes, the taboos and emerging narrative themes in a "deep dive" critical analysis! Before finally taking a look at what everyone else thought about the chapter by having an open-minded peek at the comment section!
